title: Livestream Runtime Sync — Agenda & Action Tracker (Noah)
content:
Purpose: quick, focused weekly sync for serving runtime + infra + console — surface regressions, unblock rollouts, and hatchet down action items.

Date / Cadence: weekly (Wednesdays) — next meeting: 2026-03-11 10:00–10:40 PT (40m). Mic-check at :00, livestream recording ON.

Attendees (ask if proxy): Noah (host), Sana, Diego, Priya, Arjun (SRE), Lin (console), Maya (release eng), product rep as needed.

High-level goals for this week's call:
- Confirm p95/p99 latency trend post-3/4 runtime kernel changes; decide rollback or canarying.
- Progress on KV/prefix cache dashboard and sampling profiler.
- Agree on console visibility items required for next Dedicated customer demo.
- Clear top blocking PRs and assign owners for unblock.

Pre-reads (please skim before meeting):
- INFRA-4823 ticket thread + Diego's perf notes (linked_artifacts).
- Quick dashboard snapshot: p95 latency (avg last 7d) 142ms -> spiked to 188ms on 3/04; error-rate remained ~0.12%.
- Canary rollout plan draft: see GH PR 887.

Agenda (time-boxed):
1) 00:00–00:03 — Quick status (Noah): last week's action quick pass, any immediate show-stoppers.
2) 00:03–00:12 — Perf deep-dive (Diego + data slice): p95/p99 across regions, affected models, request-size distribution. (Goal: decide healthy->canary/rollback)
3) 00:12–00:20 — KV cache & sampling profiler update (Sana): dashboard preview and missing traces. (Goal: agree on monitoring events and cost budget.)
4) 00:20–00:30 — Console visibility ask (Lin): three widgets needed for Dedicated demo — token-level cost, per-route latency, fallback counts. Quick feasibility check.
5) 00:30–00:36 — Blockers/PRs (Maya): top 3 PRs blocking release; assign temporary owners.
6) 00:36–00:40 — Decisions & Next steps (Noah): confirm action owners, set follow-up mini-check (if needed).

Backline notes / backup items (if time permits):
- Incident review notes from 2026-03-04 (short RCA draft).
- Autoscaler tweak experiment (Arjun) results.

Risks & open questions to surface in sync:
- Is the latency spike correlated with specific quantization profiles? (Diego to share sample traces.)
- Console telemetry lag: is the ingestion pipeline causing stale metrics for live demos? (Lin to validate retention window.)
- Can we enforce a soft SLO to throttle expensive model variants at the gateway while preserving throughput? (Discuss feasibility.)

Desired decisions by end of meeting:
- Canary now vs. postpone one week.
- Console widgets list for demo and who will implement them.
- Prioritized list of PRs to unblock (owner + target date).

Notes for host (Noah):
- Start recording at session start and ping #runtime for live questions; encourage one-line status updates from attendees.
- If decision requires >2 assignees, create a follow-up breakout.

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack + ticket comments):
- Meeting summary: 2 sentences.
- Decisions made: bullet list.
- Action items: owner — task — due date.
- Next sync: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT.
action_items: Diego Martinez — Produce filtered p95/p99 traces by model family and region; attach profiler samples to INFRA-4823 — due 2026-03-15
Sana Li — Finalize KV/prefix cache dashboard panels and add sampling rate metric; post link in #runtime-monitoring — due 2026-03-14
Lin Park — Prototype three console widgets for Dedicated demo (token-cost, per-route p95, fallback count) and share screenshots — due 2026-03-16
Noah Patel — Draft short canary contingency plan (criteria for rollback + traffic percentages) and post to GH PR 887 — due 2026-03-13
Maya Gomez — Rebase and resolve conflicts on release blocker PR #883, coordinate with reviewers — due 2026-03-12
Arjun Khatri — Run autoscaler sensitivity job for peak-hour traffic pattern and share summary; call out if it increases cold-start risk — due 2026-03-17
Priya Reddy — Prepare two customer-facing bullet points on expected latencies for the Dedicated demo deck — due 2026-03-16
